So delivery Friday nahi hogi, now it's Monday. Priya ko bata dena ki delivery Monday hai, but don't tell her the vendor shorted us, just say revised schedule. Suresh ko bolo ki Monday subah teen log chahiye unloading ke liye. And Ramesh se confirm karo baaki ek sau pachaas cartons parso tak aa jaayein. Anita ko main khud batata hoon ki client ko inform kar diya.
